shortDescription: Create, update or delete a vpc via the marketplace.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Fully qualified URL to the API.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Optional availability group. Will be used for all instances provisioned in this tenant

options.name: customer
options.description: The name or UUID of the customer to filter the project lookup. This is useful when a project name is not unique across all customers.

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval in seconds for polling the async action status.

options.name: limits
options.description: Marketplace resource limits for limit-based billing. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: offering
options.description: The name or UUID of the marketplace offering. Required when C(state) is 'present'. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: plan
options.description: URL of the marketplace plan. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: project
options.description: The name or UUID of the project. Required when C(state) is 'present'. This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: security_groups
options.description: A list of security groups names or UUIDs.

options.name: skip_connection_extnet
options.description: Skip connection extnet This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: skip_creation_of_default_subnet
options.description: Skip creation of default subnet This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: subnet_cidr
options.description: Subnet CIDR This attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for the async action to complete.

options.name: wait
options.description: A boolean value that defines whether to wait for the async action to complete.
